decisions.reason: The existing message-843 MODIFY already marks the legacy main-board stack inapplicable and removes layer_count, so no further change is required.
The project topology was already a single integrated board before this Event; the source merely relies on that architecture and does not change it.
The existing message-843 MODIFY already records the permitted connector-side placement while preserving the explicit edge and grouping constraints from message 842.
The source relaxes connector placement only; it does not alter the antenna edge placement, battery-facing orientation, or minimum keepout requirements.
Connector-placement flexibility does not determine or revoke the four-layer stack, and propagation would require assuming an unstated layer-stack decision for the integrated board.
The source contains no layer-stack decision and the candidate has no client-confirmed layer-count attribute to update or remove.
The source does not change the integrated architecture, cost objective, component-selection policy, or reduced-interboard-connector strategy already in state.
Freedom to position connectors does not change the required external sensor connector fanout, and elimination of interboard inputs was already captured earlier.
The source does not change the panel button connector, PWRON behavior, integrated-board location, or electrical connection, and no conflicting connector-side constraint exists in this Requirement.
